roles.source_role: Additive cis expression-QTL analysis in two separately prepared colon-expression cohorts, followed by separate META/SMR tools.
roles.use_summary: Matrix eQTL 2.3 fits cis expression associations in GTEx transverse-colon and SOCCS mucosa cohorts; the study separately prepares expression residuals, restricts loci/MAF and combines associations for SMR.
roles.runtime_scope: Native 2.3 additive association, explicit covariates or caller-prepared residuals, complete ordered SNP/gene positions and declared cis distance.
roles.remaining_scope: The paper reports 367 GTEx and 223 SOCCS samples, a 0.5 Mb lead-locus variant restriction, MAF >0.01 and gene associations within 1 Mb. PEER/age/sex/batch preparation, cohort membership, locus/MAF restriction, META1.7 and SMR1.3.1 are separate and not reproduced.

roles.source_role: Additive methylation-QTL model with five genotype PCs, ten methylation PCs, sex and SentrixID batch; cis 500 kb.
roles.use_summary: MatrixEQTL 2.3 tests cis methylation QTLs within 500 kb after explicit genotype-PC, methylation-PC, sex and batch adjustment; significance uses FDR or Bonferroni from the total tested-pair count.
roles.runtime_scope: Native 2.3 additive association with caller-encoded numeric covariates, inclusive cis interval, complete pair denominator and separate source BH FDR.
roles.remaining_scope: The original automatic version field remains null; primary text explicitly supplies 2.3. The developmental-stage signal is represented through methylation PC1 rather than an additional stage covariate. PC estimation, factor encoding, study membership and downstream EnsDb annotation are separate.

roles.source_role: Sex- and cell-type-stratified SNP-gene coefficient and SE extraction for subsequent sex-difference tests and filtering.
roles.use_summary: MatrixEQTL supplies stratified SNP-gene effect estimates and standard errors for comparison across sexes and cell types; the paper then applies chromosome-level FDR, lead selection and an opposite-sex consistency filter.
roles.runtime_scope: Explicit independent stratum inputs to the native 2.3 additive kernel; beta and separately derived SE, independently checked against ordinary/full GLS regression. The paper does not identify a MatrixEQTL version.
roles.remaining_scope: This is not evidence that the paper used version2.3 or the LINEAR_CROSS model. Cell aggregation, stratum membership, chromosome testing families, lead selection, two-sample Z tests and distributional consistency filtering remain separate. The source leaves its pi0 threshold as literal X; no threshold is invented.

roles.source_role: Additive cis/trans skin methylation-QTL association followed by a study-specific block-permutation FDR analysis.
roles.use_summary: MatrixEQTL 2.3 tests adjusted skin-methylation residuals against genotypes, retaining cis p<1e-3 and trans p<1e-5; twenty genotype permutations preserve twin pairs within zygosity groups for subsequent empirical FDR.
roles.runtime_scope: Native 2.3 additive cis/trans association, separate nominal thresholds, total pair counts and per-feature minimum p-values on each explicitly supplied observed or permuted dataset.
roles.remaining_scope: The study describes cis <1 Mb and trans >1 Mb or different chromosomes; the exact 1 Mb boundary is unspecified, whereas package behavior is inclusive. Dosage orientation must already represent the intended effect allele. Twin/zygosity block permutations, per-CpG best-hit aggregation and author empirical FDR are not replaced by BH. The reported study-wide significance thresholds are not general defaults. GoDMC preparation and 394-female-twin cohort reproduction remain separate.
